jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for "experts" to join an unpaid Advisory Committee, not a paid entry-level role — it seeks established specialists to advise a project, which the candidate is not, and there is no salaried vacancy. Although the human-rights/securitisation subject is on-mission, it is a volunteer advisory position rather than a genuine paid job.
